timeline.summary: Samhi Hotels executed a corporate guarantee of up to ₹453.10 Cr in favour of Citibank N.A. for its 100% subsidiary SAMHI Hotels (Ahmedabad) Private Limited.
Samhi Hotels reported Q4 FY26 consolidated total income of ₹353.5 Cr and PAT of ₹399.4 Cr.
Sanjay Jain, Senior Director - Corporate Affairs, shared the audio recording of the earnings call on audited Q4:FY26 results on May 22, 2026, available at samhi.co.in.
Samhi Hotels reported Q4 FY26 total income of ₹354 Cr and FY26 net profit of ₹567 Cr.

Samhi Hotels Limited scheduled an earnings call on Unaudited Financial Results for quarter and six months ended 30 September 2026 for investors/analysts on Wednesday 04 November 2026 at 09:30 a.m. (IST).
